extension.description: Install and update MBOptScrapers and the CocoScrapers bridge.

extension.summary: MBOptScrapers - torrent scrapers for debrid services
extension.description: Scraper module for video add-ons: searches 16 torrent providers (Stremio APIs, JSON APIs, RSS and HTML) and returns magnet links for debrid services.[CR]Rebuilt from CocoScrapers 1.0.32 (CocoJoe, GPL-3.0), itself based on FenomScrapers. Install the "CocoScrapers bridge" add-on to keep add-ons that expect CocoScrapers (Umbrella, Fen...) working.

extension.news: v1.0.0: first MBOptScrapers release, rebuilt from CocoScrapers 1.0.32. See the changelog in the settings.

extension.summary: Compatibility bridge: CocoScrapers is now MBOptScrapers
extension.description: Contains no scrapers. Video add-ons that look for CocoScrapers (Umbrella, Fen...) are transparently redirected to MBOptScrapers. Configure providers in the MBOptScrapers settings.
extension.news: v2.0.0: replaces CocoScrapers with a bridge to MBOptScrapers.
